title: Exactness at Inference: A Representational Criterion for Out-of-Distribution Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2609.24942v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A model generalizes outside its training distribution only when it computes a representation structurally equivalent to the generating mechanism, not an approximation fitted to it. Such equivalence is necessary for exactness in and out of distribution, and extrapolation is governed by this exactness at inference, whatever its realization. Tensor Logic shows this: a zero-temperature contraction is equivalent to discrete logic, deducing in place with no artefact extracted, its tensors Boolean, its embeddings orthonormal, only its arithmetic continuous. Lacking infinite recursion it reaches Datalog, not Prolog, and though exact over closed domains it needs external memory to bind a novel entity. The criterion needs neither a discrete representation nor an extracted expression, and constrains inference, not training: an exact marginal in $[0,1]$ passes, a Neural Network thresholded to a hard label does not. translated_title: 推理时的精确性：分布外泛化的表征性判据
translated_abstract: 只有当模型计算出的表征在结构上等价于数据的生成机制，而非拟合于该机制的近似时，模型才能在训练分布之外实现泛化。这种等价性对于分布内外的精确性都是必要的，而外推由推理时的这种精确性所支配，无论其具体实现方式如何。张量逻辑展示了这一点：零温度缩并等价于离散逻辑，可就地推理而无需提取任何人工产物，其张量是布尔型的，其嵌入是正交归一的，只有其算术是连续的。由于缺乏无限递归，它只能达到 Datalog 而非 Prolog；尽管在封闭域上是精确的，它仍需要外部记忆来绑定新实体。该判据既不需要离散表征，也不需要提取出的表达式，且约束的是推理而非训练：[0,1] 中的精确边缘概率可以通过该判据，而阈值化为硬标签的神经网络则不能。逻辑张量网络未能满足该判据，而……
tldr: 模型只有在推理时计算出与数据生成机制结构等价的表征才能实现分布外泛化，本文据此提出以“推理精确性”为核心的表征判据——它不要求离散表征或提取出的表达式，只约束推理而非训练，并以张量逻辑为例加以验证。
en_tdlr: A model generalizes out-of-distribution only when its inference-time representation is structurally equivalent to the generating mechanism; the paper proposes this exactness-at-inference criterion—which constrains inference rather than training and requires neither discrete representations nor extracted expressions—and illustrates it with Tensor Logic.
